sensors.name: right light sensor RLIGHT (light from above)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if the right light sensor reads more than 75, drive forward at 30 %; else stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line; in a dark tunnel with no line, drive straight through without touching the walls; follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads more than 75 %

branches.outcome: bright: it drives straight forward at 30 %
dim: it calls the wall check

branches.reason: In the simulator nothing goes inside a tunnel unless you said what the robot should do at a wall in the dark, and a tunnel's own walls only come in front of the robot in a bend; you didn't say what it should do at a wall in the dark, so no scenario can put an obstacle in front of it in dim light.
branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops
nothing ahead: it follows the line

input_dimensions.dimension: what the line tracker sees on the floor

equivalence_classes: bright light again, after the tunnel

scenarios.coded_response: It drives straight forward at 30 % and never steers by the line.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a black line in bright light.
scenarios.trigger: The line bends under the line tracker.
scenarios.title: Follows the black line
assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line to its end.

scenarios.coded_response: In dim light with no obstacle ahead it follows the line, and where there is no line it curves right (left wheel 40 %, right 10 %).
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot follows a line in bright light into a straight tunnel; deeper in, the line stops and nothing is in front of it.
scenarios.trigger: The light under the roof falls below 75 %.
scenarios.title: Drives straight through a dark tunnel without a line
assumptions: The tunnel runs straight on the line's course.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It drives straight through the dark part of the tunnel and comes out without touching the walls.

scenarios.coded_response: It drives straight forward at 30 %: in bright light it never reads the line tracker.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot has come through the dark part of a tunnel and a line runs on after the exit.
scenarios.title: Follows the line again after the tunnel

uncertainties: In bright light your program drives straight and never reads the line tracker, so it can't follow the line there.
In dim light it follows the line, and with no line under it it curves right instead of driving straight.
You didn't say what the robot should do at a wall in the dark, so the stop at an obstacle gets no scenario and no path targets it.
After the dark, a right program may come out beside the line, so following the line again is hard to decide.
